paper.title_en: Kerr geodesics on conformal projection diagrams
paper.abstract_en: We provide a rigorous representation of timelike geodesics in the maximally extended Kerr spacetime, using projection diagrams introduced by Chruściel, Ölz, and Szybka. In contrast to standard conformal diagrams, projection diagrams allow for plotting general causal curves (not necessarily confined to the two-dimensional surface associated with the diagram), preserving their causal characteristics. Our analysis utilizes two systems of horizon-penetrating coordinates (both ingoing and outgoing) to ensure a regular description of geodesics crossing the event and Cauchy horizons. On the other hand, at most four causal blocks can be joined smoothly by a Kruskal-Szekeres-type construction proposed for projection diagrams. Consequently, depicting a trajectory spanning several causal blocks may require more than one diagram, as the conformal factor either vanishes or diverges at the block boundaries.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文在最大延拓Kerr时空中对类时测地线给出了严格的投影图表示，使用了两种穿透视界的坐标系来处理事件视界与Cauchy视界的穿越，并讨论了因果块边界处共形因子的行为。该工作对广义相对论基础与黑洞时空因果结构研究具有明确的理论深度与方法论价值，适合相应方向的研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 共形投影图上的Kerr测地线
decision.abstract_zh: 我们利用Chruściel、Ölz和Szybka引入的投影图，对最大延拓Kerr时空中的类时测地线给出了严格的表示。与标准共形图不同，投影图允许绘制一般因果曲线（不必局限于与图相关的二维曲面），同时保持其因果特征。我们的分析使用两套穿透视界的坐标系（入射与出射），以确保对穿越事件视界和Cauchy视界的测地线进行正则描述。另一方面，对于投影图，通过Kruskal-Szekeres型构造最多可以光滑地连接四个因果块。因此，描绘跨越多个因果块的轨迹可能需要多于一个图，因为共形因子在块边界处要么消失要么发散。
